responsibility: Declares the D front end’s template system representation. It defines tuples and argument lists, template declarations with parameter lists, constraints, overload chains, and instantiation caches, the hierarchy of type/value/alias/this/tuple template parameters, and template instances/mixins with deduced arguments, imported modules, aliasing, and codegen-need tracking, making this the core AST and bookkeeping layer for template matching, specialization ordering, instantiation, and mixin expansion.
